LENGTH: Field "{label}" length must be between {min} and {max} characters
MIN_LENGTH: Field "{label}" must be at least {min} characters long
MAX_LENGTH: Field "{label}" must be at most {max} characters long
ARRAY_MIN_SIZE: Field "{label}" must contain at least {min} items
ARRAY_MAX_SIZE: Field "{label}" must contain at most {max} items
IS_EMAIL: Field "{label}" must be a valid email address
IS_UUID: Field "{label}" must be a valid UUID (v{version})
IS_PHONE: Field "{label}" must be a valid phone number ({region})
IS_POSITIVE: Field "{label}" must be a positive number
MIN: Field "{label}" must be greater than or equal to {min}
MAX: Field "{label}" must be less than or equal to {max}
IS_DECIMAL: Field "{label}" must be a decimal number
IS_DATE: Field "{label}" must be a valid date
ARRAY_UNIQUE: All items in "{label}" must be unique
IS_CREDIT_CARD: Field "{label}" must be a valid credit card number
IS_ORDINAL: Field "{label}" must be an ordinal value
